changelog: Production ready zero initial state, schedule/planner builder with quick presets, and custom activities/habits
Interactive Tutorial Onboarding, secure on-device authorization vault, and clean initial fresh start
Production-Ready Release: Genuine signed Android release binary (11 MB) distributed on GitHub Releases.
Hardware Release Keystore: Signed with dedicated RSA 2048-bit production keystore with v2 & v3 signature schemes.
User Authentication & Android KeyStore Vault: Hardware-backed AES-GCM encrypted session storage supporting Login, Registration, and Offline Guest modes.
Streamlined 4-Tab Navigation: Consolidated app sections into Today, Planner (integrated Schedule & Habits), Insights, and Account.
